Metadata.name: Sakhi Severe Voice Alert
Metadata.description: Speaks the severe SOS message with dynamic victim name, then disconnects. Attributes VictimName and MapsUrl are passed in by Sakhi_TriggerVoiceCall's start_outbound_voice_contact call.

Parameters.Text: Urgent Sakhi S O S. $.Attributes.VictimName did not respond to the safety timer. This is an active emergency. A live tracking link has already been sent by text message. Please check on them immediately.
